fields.description: How this step is listed here, e.g. “3 · Consent”. Never shown to a customer.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: The big heading at the top of this step. Leave empty to keep the wording that ships in code — the preview beside this form shows you what that is. It may not use clinical words (consultation, diagnosis, treatment, specialist, physician, clinician, neurologist, prescription): this is a wellness assessment, and saving is blocked if it does.

fields.name: subtitle

fields.name: terms
fields.label: Consent terms
fields.description: The agreement shown in the scrolling box on this step, which a customer must accept before paying. Markdown: headings, bold, lists and links. Leave it empty and the terms that ship in code are shown instead.

fields.name: termsVersion
fields.label: Consent terms version
fields.description: Stamped on every consent record as proof of WHICH terms that customer agreed to, so change it whenever you change the terms above — a date like 2026-08-13 is ideal. Leave it empty and consents are recorded against the version that ships in code. Existing records are never rewritten.
